nodes.label: RLS Security Test Plan
nodes.rationale: 20 SQL checks split into 10 that must pass (admin sees all sites, installer sees only site_assignments-linked sites, installer can open/close own time_entries, update assigned site_checklists, insert photos, update own user_profiles) and 10 that must be blocked (cross-installer reads, installer INSERT into sites/site_assignments/checklist_templates, editing closed time_entries — the UPDATE policy requires end_time IS NULL — and editing other users' profiles). Uses Supabase 'Impersonate role' in SQL Editor for auth context.

nodes.label: Row Level Security Policies (Supabase)
nodes.rationale: RLS governs sites, site_assignments, time_entries, site_checklists, checklist_templates, photos, and user_profiles: admins have full access; installers are scoped to assigned sites via site_assignments and to their own rows via auth.uid(); checklist_templates are readable by all authenticated users but writable only by admins; closed time entries are immutable.
